master: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SINGLE production-minded prototype sprite for PRIMAL RUN, a top-down pixel-art dinosaur roguelite. Create a brand-new juvenile UTAHRAPTOR game sprite, one dinosaur only, facing SOUTH (snout toward bottom edge, long tail toward top edge). Camera directly above with just a slight 15-degree tilt; visible back and both thighs, never a side profile. Semi-realistic anatomy: long stiff tail, narrow raptor head, small feathered forearms, two legs with sickle claws; no extra limbs. Colors earthy rust-brown body, warm tan underside, dark umber striping, tiny amber eyes. Light from upper left. Hand-authored-looking low-resolution pixel art, bold coherent pixel clusters and clean hard edges, restricted 16-color palette, no gradients, no antialiasing, no painterly microtexture. Composition: exact square image, transparent background, dinosaur fits inside central 70% height and 40% width, body pelvis precisely centered in the canvas, generous transparent margin all around. Native sprite intended for a 128x128 pixel canvas; render large pixel blocks as a clean integer enlargement of a 128x128 sprite. This is ONE static neutral standing pose, not a sheet. No text, labels, border, UI, ground, cast shadow, checkerboard, signature or watermark. This will be the anatomy, palette and perspective master for future frames.
grass: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one seamless terrain tile for PRIMAL RUN, a top-down semi-realistic pixel-art dinosaur roguelite. Generate a square fern-forest GRASS TILE, flat overhead terrain. Muted olive-green grass with a few tiny restrained grass clusters, mostly calm walkable surface. Hand-authored-looking low-resolution pixel art, clean hard-edged pixel clusters, 8-12 colors, no gradients, no antialiasing, no blur or painterly microtexture. Palette: #151b19 #28372a #3f5030 #586d38 #799447 #a8b15b #ded392. Native target is a 32x32 tile shown as a clean integer enlargement, visibly chunky pixels. It must fill entire square, completely opaque with no transparent pixels. All four edges match seamlessly when repeated horizontally and vertically; uniform brightness all the way to edges, no vignette, no border and no drop shadow. No isolated trees, dinosaurs, rocks, flowers, text, labels, grid or watermark. SINGLE TILE only, no contact sheet.
